title: 婕拉·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 绯红花瓣头发与叶片饰物相映，绿色藤蔓围绕完整衣装的花卉轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Zyra is an adult plantlike woman with a recognizable composed face, long crimson petal-shaped hair, leaf-shaped head ornaments and a botanical identity. Keep her adult face and natural adult proportions. Her complete torso, arms and legs are covered by an opaque high-neck long-sleeved jade cloth coat, an ivory shirt, deep-teal trousers, gloves and boots. Botanical features appear in her hair, small leaf ornaments and vine-shaped clothing trim; the clothing itself is ordinary opaque woven fabric.
art_direction.scene: A bright original full-figure portrait of Zyra, an ADULT botanical guardian, standing calmly in a sunlit garden courtyard. Her distinctive composed adult face, long CRIMSON PETAL-SHAPED HAIR and leaf-shaped head ornaments are the strongest identity features. She wears a TAILORED HIGH-NECK JADE-GREEN LONG COAT made of visibly opaque woven fabric, with long sleeves and overlapping leaf-shaped fabric panels, over a complete ivory shirt, opaque deep-teal trousers, full gloves and sturdy closed boots. The coat is closed from neck through waist; the complete torso and legs are covered with ordinary opaque fabric layers. Floral embroidery and small vine-shaped gold trim decorate the clothing. Both hands are EMPTY and relaxed naturally by her sides. Confident poised adult proportions, no additional beings. Background is only a few pale trellis and leaf sketches, with no dense foliage obscuring her body. Bright crimson, coral, fresh emerald, pale turquoise and warm lemon sunlight, confident graphite contours and colorful pencil cross-hatching on luminous warm-white paper. Plain surfaces without lettering or badges.
art_direction.palette: leaf green, crimson, emerald, pale sun gold; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
